tasks.title: reconstruct, eligibilityPass and applyBusMessage have a production caller: the daemon start and a bus request poll, both through the vault
requirements: a vault method vault.tasksStart() runs reconstruct(project) for every project that has a store and then eligibilityPass(project) for each, with no send port, so it offers and dispatches nothing until an adapter exists (SO-05-B); expired leases are marked on start and the pass skips a task with a live lease and every task of a paused project (source: SO-08-B AC02)

the daemon (src/server/main.mjs) calls vault.tasksStart() once after the vault opens and before it serves requests that claim tasks, and nothing in the daemon names a store or a Coordinator (source: SO-1.01 requirement 3)

a vault method vault.tasksApplyRequests() reads the bus messages of type task that the operator seat posted with a body {request: cancel, pause or resume, project, task, reason} and applies each through applyBusMessage once; the message id is the id of the message on the bus (its device file and seq), so a message read twice, by this process or another, changes the project once; a message from a seat that is not the operator, with a bad body or with no reason on a cancel is ignored and changes nothing (source: SO-08-B AC05; docs/BUS.md, Project messages)

the daemon calls vault.tasksApplyRequests() every vault.config.projects.poll_ms milliseconds (default 5000, 0 turns it off), with an unref'd timer that stops on shutdown, and a failure of one pass is logged and never ends the daemon (source: src/server/main.mjs, the existing flush timer)

SR-1.15: no code without a caller; reconstruct, eligibilityPass and applyBusMessage are each reachable from the daemon, shown by tests that start the daemon (source: docs/scope-one/WBS.md leaf 2.2.15)
tasks.description: Repo: memev. Coordinator.reconstruct, eligibilityPass and applyBusMessage (SO-08-B, pull request #361) have no caller outside tests, so a daemon restart reconstructs nothing and a cancel, pause or resume posted on the bus is never read. The daemon is the production entry that runs at start and keeps running, and the vault is the one place that may reach the Coordinator, so the daemon calls two vault methods. The carrier of a request on the bus is the existing message type task with a JSON body from the operator seat; no new message type is added. Dispatching an offered task to an adapter, and the capability record (SO-05-B), are not part of this task.

title: SO-W-08C Production callers for recovery and control, and the bus for the Coordinator
request: Production callers for the recovery and control functions of SO-08-B, and the bus for the Coordinator. Proposed and unsigned; the signer signs it after the red-team gate. Maps to PG-08.1, task WP08-02, as SO-W-08B does. Id: SO-W-08C, not SO-08-C, because the gate reduces a file name such as SO-08-C.json to the id SO-08, which it would share with SO-W-08B. Why: pull request #361 builds recover, reconstruct, eligibilityPass and applyBusMessage and the Coordinator's bus option, and its own notes say none has a production caller and the vault does not give the Coordinator the bus (docs/scope-one/RECONCILIATION.md, Open follow-ups: 'Production caller for recovery and reconstruction' and 'Give the Coordinator the bus'). By SR-1.15 (no code without a caller) code without a caller is to be wired or removed. Where the callers live: SO-1.01 requirement 3 allows only the vault, the coordinator and the project store to reach the store, so the callers are vault methods; the MCP server calls a vault method for recover (T2), and the daemon, which runs at start and keeps running, calls the vault at start and on a timer (T3). The vault builds the Coordinator with its bus (T1). Checked: no existing spec covers it (a search of contracts/ and docs/ for these four functions finds only the register). It stays inside the same boundary as SO-08-B: no new bus message type, no dispatch to an adapter (SO-05-B), no second store. Still open and not covered: the capability record (waits on SO-05-B) and the bus seat names for vault claims (name/client is not a seat name). Depends on contracts: SO-W-08B (the repository text of the signed vault contract SO-08-B, recovery and control; pull request #361, a draft stacked on #350) and pull request #350 (its base): this contract starts once #361 merges, because recover, reconstruct, eligibilityPass and applyBusMessage and the Coordinator's bus option exist only there; SO-1.01 (the one store authority) and SO-A-03. Owner decisions of 31 Oct 2026 apply: local-first topology, the cloud only a relay and a backup; every supported provider on equal footing; crdt-merge reached only through the provider boundary of src/engine/merge.mjs; no second database for project state.
